title: IntactWorld: Joint World Modeling with Intact Features
title_zh: IntactWorld：基于完整特征的联合世界建模

paragraphs.en: While recent video generation models synthesize highly realistic visuals, they lack a genuine understanding of intrinsic real-world logic. Existing methods attempt to understand the world by internalizing diverse world knowledge, yet constrained by computational overhead or dimensionality alignment, their learning processes inevitably compress features, causing a severe loss of structural information. To address this, we propose IntactWorld , a Joint World Modeling Architecture utilizing uncompressed Intact Features . Since data naturally reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a high-dimensional space, predicting the flow velocity v v within this uncompressed high-dimensional space induces a severe manifold gap. To successfully eliminate this optimization bottleneck, our framework instead predicts the clean feature x 0 x_{0} at intermediate layers. Furthermore, to mitigate the computational overhead of incorporating complete world knowledge, we introduce a Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm . By replacing raw full features with highly refined CLS tokens, this paradigm enables efficient single-branch guidance, reducing spatial memory consumption by 11.4% and cutting inference latency by 43.8%. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of IntactWorld, outperforming established baselines by 2.46 points on the VBench 2.0 benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管近期的视频生成模型能够合成高度逼真的视觉效果，但它们缺乏对现实世界内在逻辑的真正理解。 现有方法试图通过内化多样化的世界知识来理解世界，但由于受到计算开销或维度对齐的限制，其学习过程不可避免地会压缩特征，导致结构信息的严重丢失。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 IntactWorld——一种利用未压缩完整特征的联合世界建模架构。 由于数据天然存在于高维空间中的低维流形上，预测该未压缩高维空间内的流速度 v 会导致严重的流形间隙。 为了成功消除这一优化瓶颈，我们的框架转而预测中间层中的纯净特征 x₀。 此外，为减轻融入完整世界知识所带来的计算开销，我们引入了一种“全量到紧凑”的训练范式。 通过将原始全量特征替换为高度精炼的 CLS 标记，该范式实现了高效的单分支引导，使空间内存消耗降低了 11.4%，推理延迟减少了 43.8%。 广泛评估表明 IntactWorld 具有显著效果，在 VBench 2.0 基准测试中比现有基线模型高出 2.46 分。

paragraphs.en: Recent advancements in Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) ( Rombach et al. 2022 ) and Diffusion Transformers (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie 2023 ) have significantly propelled video generation. Foundation models such as CogVideoX ( Yang et al. 2025 ) , HunyuanVideo ( Kong et al. 2025 ) , and Wan2.1 ( Wan et al. 2025 ) can now synthesize highly realistic visual sequences. Despite this impressive visual fidelity, these architectures usually operate as pixel-level pattern matchers. Optimized primarily for surface-level statistical distributions, they often struggle to capture the intrinsic logic of the real world. This fundamental limitation is reflected by their performance on world-centric benchmarks such as VBench 2.0 ( Zheng et al. 2025 ) . These limitations suggest that generative frameworks should move beyond pixel-level dependencies and incorporate richer world knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在扩散模型（LDMs）（Rombach 等人，2022）和扩散变换器（DiT）（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）的最新进展显著推动了视频生成技术的发展。 像 CogVideoX（Yang 等人，2025）、HunyuanVideo（Kong 等人，2025）和 Wan2.1（Wan 等人，2025）这样的基础模型如今能够合成高度逼真的视觉序列。 尽管这些模型具有令人印象深刻的视觉保真度，但它们通常仅作为像素级的模式匹配器运行。 由于主要针对表层统计分布进行优化，它们往往难以捕捉真实世界的内在逻辑。 这一根本性局限反映在它们在 VBench 2.0（Zheng 等人，2025）等以世界为中心基准测试中的表现上。 这些局限性表明，生成式框架应超越像素级的依赖关系，并融入更丰富的世界知识。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods ( Lin et al. 2025 ; Brooks et al. 2024 ; Yuan et al. 2026 ; Yang et al. 2026 ; Zhu et al. 2024 ) have sought to equip video generators with external priors to facilitate genuine world modeling. Approaches like DreamWorld ( Tan et al. 2026 ) extend projection layers to explicitly internalize multi-modal knowledge. To manage the resulting computational overhead, they heavily rely on dimensionality reduction techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) ( Kouzelis et al. 2026 ) . However, this compression erases structural details, specifically spatial and motion information, causing the model to overfit to generalized semantics. Alternatively, discarding PCA to train directly on uncompressed full features introduces a critical optimization bottleneck. Diffusion models typically predict the velocity vector v v . According to the manifold hypothesis ( Li and He 2026 ) , data naturally resides on a low-dimensional manifold within a high-dimensional space. Therefore, directly predicting v v in this uncompressed high-dimensional space induces significant optimization loss, which degrades the overall generative capacity of the model (as detailed in Section 4.4).
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法（Lin et al. 2025；Brooks et al. 2024；Yuan et al. 2026；Yang et al. 2026；Zhu et al. 2024）试图为视频生成器配备外部先验知识，以促使其实现真实的世界建模。 像 DreamWorld（Tan et al. 2026）这样的方法通过扩展投影层，将多模态知识显式地内化到模型中。 为了管理由此产生的计算开销，这些方法严重依赖降维技术，例如主成分分析（PCA）（Kouzelis et al. 2026）。 然而，这种压缩会抹除结构细节，特别是空间信息和运动信息，导致模型对泛化的语义产生过拟合。 另一种做法是放弃 PCA，直接对未压缩的完整特征进行训练，但这会引入一个关键的优化瓶颈。 扩散模型通常预测速度向量 v v。 根据流形假设（Li and He 2026），数据天然存在于高维空间中的一个低维流形上。 因此，直接在此未压缩的高维空间中预测 v v 会导致显著的优化损失，从而降低模型的总体生成能力（详见第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we propose IntactWorld , a Joint World Modeling Architecture utilizing Intact Features . Inspired by DreamWorld, we extend projection layers to internalize knowledge, but incorporate uncompressed full DINOv2 ( Oquab et al. 2023 ) and VGGT ( Wang et al. 2025a ) features. To circumvent the manifold gap bottleneck caused by directly predicting v v in a high-dimensional space ( Li and He 2026 ) , our model avoids directly predicting velocity for the world features. Instead, it predicts clean world features x 0 x_{0} while retaining velocity prediction for the VAE latents, and computes the training loss in velocity space. Furthermore, since intermediate network layers preserve richer structural information, we predict x 0 x_{0} from these intermediate layers rather than the final layer.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一差距，我们提出了 IntactWorld——一种利用完整特征的联合世界建模架构。 受 DreamWorld 的启发，我们将投影层扩展以内部化知识，但整合了未压缩的完整 DINOv2（Oquab 等人，2023）和 VGGT（Wang 等人，2025a）特征。 为避免直接在高维空间中预测 v v 所导致的流形差距瓶颈（Li 和 He，2026），我们的模型避免直接预测世界特征的速度。 相反，它预测干净的世界特征 x₀ x_{0}，同时保留对 VAE 潜变量的速度预测，并在速度空间中计算训练损失。 此外，由于中间网络层保留了更丰富的结构信息，我们从这些中间层而非最终层来预测 x₀ x_{0}。

paragraphs.en: However, incorporating external world knowledge inevitably increases inference costs. For instance, DreamWorld employs a Multi-Source Inner-Guidance mechanism, which requires constructing multiple auxiliary branches on top of standard classifier-free guidance(CFG) ( Vincent 2011 ; Ho and Salimans 2022 ) . To address this, we propose a Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm . Building upon the full-feature learning of Stage I, Stage II uses compact CLS tokens and concatenates them with the VAE latents in the hidden layers. Since these CLS tokens have already internalized the world knowledge and are highly condensed, they inherently provide strong guidance. Consequently, instead of requiring multiple branches, we only need to construct a single additional CLS feature branch alongside standard CFG, which drastically reduces inference overhead. paragraphs.en: The development of video generation builds upon latent diffusion models (LDMs) ( Rombach et al. 2022 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Ma et al. 2025 ) , which operate in a compressed latent space to enable efficient synthesis while preserving perceptual quality. Early approaches such as VideoCrafter1 ( Chen et al. 2023 ) and ModelScope ( Wang et al. 2023 ) extend UNet-based architectures with interleaved spatial and temporal attention modules to capture frame dependencies. Subsequently, the field has shifted toward Diffusion Transformers (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie 2023 ) , replacing convolutional U-Nets with pure transformer backbones that better scale with model size and sequence length. Foundational models including Sora ( Brooks et al. 2024 ) , CogVideoX ( Yang et al. 2025 ) , HunyuanVideo ( Kong et al. 2025 ) and Wan2.1 ( Wan et al. 2025 ) leverage large-scale DiT architectures, often combined with Flow Matching ( Lipman et al. 2023 ) frameworks, which enables straighter and faster generation while maintaining high fidelity.

paragraphs.en: World models ( Ha and Schmidhuber 2018 ) are already being developed in the field of video generation. paragraphs.en: The manifold hypothesis posits that natural data reside on a low-dimensional manifold embedded in a high-dimensional space, whereas noise or noised quantities lie off this manifold. Drawing on this perspective, JiT ( Li and He 2026 ) proposes directly predicting clean data ( x x -prediction), demonstrating that even networks with limited capacity can handle high-dimensional patches when the prediction respects manifold structure. Enforcing bottleneck or sparse structures is a common strategy for learning such low-dimensional representations ( Tishby et al. 2000 ; Alemi et al. 2016 ; Rifai et al. 2011 ; Makhzani and Frey 2014 ) . This principle has since been extended to address geometric interference, manifold-guided distillation, concept manifolds in sparse autoencoders, and manifold-aware video generation ( Kumar and Patel 2026 ; Farghly et al. 2025 ; Roy et al. 2026 ; Bhalla et al. 2026 ; Zheng et al. 2026 ; Weng et al. 2026 ) . Together, these works highlight the importance of respecting data geometry in generative modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 流形假设认为，自然数据位于嵌入高维空间中的低维流形上，而噪声或含噪声的量则位于该流形之外。 基于这一视角，JiT（Li 和 He，2026）提出直接预测干净数据（x-x预测），并证明即使网络容量有限，只要预测尊重流形结构，也能处理高维图像块。 强制采用瓶颈或稀疏结构是学习此类低维表示的常用策略（Tishby 等，2000；Alemi 等，2016；Rifai 等，2011；Makhzani 和 Frey，2014）。 此后，这一原则被扩展用于解决几何干扰、流形引导蒸馏、稀疏自编码器中的概念流形以及流形感知的视频生成问题（Kumar 和 Patel，2026；Farghly 等，2025；Roy 等，2026；Bhalla 等，2026；Zheng 等，2026；Weng 等，2026）。 这些研究共同凸显了尊重数据几何结构在生成式建模中的重要性。

paragraphs.en: We conduct our experiments on a 30K subset of the open-source WISA-80K ( Wang et al. 2025b ) dataset. All video clips are uniformly sampled to 81 frames at a spatial resolution of 480 × 832 480\times 832 . Optical flow features are extracted for the entire 30K subset ( Chefer et al. 2025 ) . To support our Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm, we extract uncompressed full DINOv2 ( Oquab et al. 2023 ) and VGGT ( Wang et al. 2025a ) features for 24K videos to train Stage I, while extracting only the compact CLS tokens for the remaining 6K videos specifically for Stage II.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在开源 WISA-80K（Wang et al. 2025b）数据集的 30K 子集上开展实验。 所有视频片段均以 480 × 832 的空间分辨率均匀采样为 81 帧。 我们为整个 30K 子集提取光流特征（Chefer et al. 2025）。 为了支持我们的“全量到紧凑”训练范式，我们从 24K 视频中提取未压缩的完整 DINOv2（Oquab et al. 2023）和 VGGT（Wang et al. 2025a）特征以训练第一阶段，而仅从其余 6K 视频中提取紧凑的 CLS token，专门用于第二阶段。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune the foundational Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan et al. 2025 ) model using 8 NVIDIA A100 (80GB) GPUs. The optimization utilizes a learning rate of 1e-5 with a per-device batch size of 2. Following our Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm, Stage I is trained for 1,500 steps, after which the learned LoRA weights are saved. Stage II is then initialized directly from these Stage I LoRA weights and trained for an additional 750 steps with batch size of 1.

paragraphs.en: Compared with the multi-source guidance in DreamWorld, our Compact Inner-Guidance significantly optimizes computational efficiency, as shown in Figure 4 . paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present IntactWorld , a Joint World Modeling Architecture that effectively internalizes intact world features. To overcome the manifold gap bottleneck in high-dimensional spaces, our method predicts the clean feature x 0 x_{0} at intermediate network layers and computes the optimization loss within the v v -space. Furthermore, we drastically reduce inference costs by introducing a Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm and a Compact Inner-Guidance mechanism . By abstracting complex world knowledge into highly condensed CLS tokens, our model achieves highly efficient generation requiring only a single additional feature branch alongside standard classifier-free guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IntactWorld successfully eliminates redundant computational overhead while establishing new records on both VBench and VBench-2.0 benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 IntactWorld——一种联合世界建模架构，能够有效地内化完整世界的特征。 为了解决高维空间中多样的间隙瓶颈问题，我们的方法在网络中间层预测干净的特征 x₀（x_{0}），并在 v-v 空间内计算优化损失。 此外，我们通过引入“全量到紧凑”训练范式和“紧凑内部引导”机制，大幅降低了推理成本。 通过将复杂的世界知识抽象为高度浓缩的 CLS 标记，我们的模型实现了高效的生成过程，仅需在标准无分类器引导的基础上增加一个额外的特征分支。 大量实验表明，IntactWorld 成功消除了冗余的计算开销，同时在 VBench 和 VBench-2.0 基准测试中创造了新的记录。
